selected_direction.selection_source: active user task delegates selection of the safest highest-value bounded checkpoint and authorizes its implementation
selected_direction.decision: Implement remote Steward continuity bootstrap only.

included_scope: Record current fork/default-branch/base identity and upstream relationship
Persist bounded Brainstorm alternatives and the selected continuity direction
Persist a buildable Research-to-Spec artifact and executable Implementation Request
Persist repository-scope verification and a durable handoff for a fresh agent
excluded_scope: Product code or runtime behavior changes
Canonical .repo-steward/state.yaml initialization until a direct checkout can compute the Repo Steward content digest
YAML authoring support from upstream issue #16
Complete offline source-project export from upstream issue #17
GitHub Actions, pull request creation, merge, deploy, release, production data or secret changes

requirements.statement: Record exact fork/upstream/base identity and discovery limitations in repository-owned durable evidence.
Persist Brainstorm proposals with context_only authority and keep selection separate from unselected ideas.
Persist an executable Implementation Request with exact base/branch/scope/rollback and separate implementation versus merge/deploy/release authority.
Change only .repo-steward/** in the implementation commit.
Do not claim runtime checks passed; explicitly retain NOT_RUN for unavailable local/npm/browser verification.

acceptance_criteria.description: Exact fork, upstream, default branch and base commit identities are durable.
Brainstorm proposals remain context-only and product ideas not selected are not implemented.
Implementation Request is bounded and preserves authority separation and rollback.
Verification distinguishes PASS from NOT_RUN and records the remote-only limitation.

evidence_register.claim: Fork default branch is main at 6b3cd5c1006ad586f10f1784aa56abd7b39d1001
Repository is a fork of bestagentkits/design-studio-ai and initially matched upstream HEAD.
Execution container could not resolve github.com for a local clone.
Continuity bootstrap is research-recommended; Brainstorm grants no implementation authority.
Bounded implementation is authorized; merge/deploy/release are not.
Implementation, verification, review, readiness and authorization remain distinct.
This checkpoint mutates only durable Steward context.
No direct checkout means no canonical Repo Steward content digest and no npm/browser execution.

non_blocking: Canonical .repo-steward/state.yaml must be initialized later from a direct checkout.
The next product checkpoint remains unselected pending local reconciliation.

verification_expectations.procedure: Re-read main immediately before mutation and confirm base identity has not drifted.
Read back persisted Brainstorm artifact and confirm context_only authority and candidate separation.
Read back Implementation Request and confirm exact identity, branch, scope, rollback and authority fields.
Compare base to implementation commit and require every changed path to begin with .repo-steward/.
Record local npm/typecheck/unit/browser checks as NOT_RUN because no direct checkout is available.

rollback: Delete the feature branch or revert only the scoped durable-context commits.
limitations: ready means buildable, not implemented and not merge-authorized.
No product/runtime acceptance is claimed by this spec.
